hypothesis: A standalone GRU4Rec-style sequential model with BPR and a conservative longer/lower-LR schedule may modestly improve within-user ranking over the baseline FM by exploiting train-period order information in users' long_view histories, which set-based history mechanisms and plain FM cannot represent. This specifically tests the still-open standalone merit of sequence modelling rather than heterogeneous blending, whose failure does not rule out single-model gains.
